newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela sees non-oil exports up at $6 bln in 97.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela sees non-oil exports up at $6 bln in 97.

text.p: The Venezuelan government has targeted non-traditional exports, which excludes oil and iron, to rise to $6.0 billion this year, up from $4.2 billion in 1996 and $4.5 billion in 1995, Trade and Industry minister Freddy Rojas Parra said.
"We want to reach $500 million of exports every month," Rojas Parra said during a seminar reviewing the first year of Venezuela's economic reform program.

Although non-traditional exports in the first two months of this year came in under Rojas Parra's target, at $681 million, they were up $87 million compared to the same period in the year before, official trade statistics show.
